data.name: Sights & Bites Circle Island Tour
data.headline: Sights & Bites Tour
data.description: Begin your adventure with a scenic drive along Oahu's coast, visiting iconic spots like Diamond Head, Halona Blowhole, and the Pali Lookout. Enjoy local treats and sights, including turtle spotting at Puaʻena Point and a visit to the Dole Plantation.
data.highlights:
- Diamond Head Lookout and Poi Donuts
- Halona "Blowhole" Lookout
- Nuuanu Pali Lookout
- Macadamia Nut Farm visit
- Lunch at a Shrimp Truck
- Puaʻena Point turtle spotting
- Dole Pineapple Plantation
data.itinerary:
- **Diamond Head Lookout**: Stunning views and Poi donuts
- **Halona Blowhole**: Watch the sea geyser
- **Pali Lookout**: Scenic and historical stop
- **Macadamia Nut Farm**: Sample local products
- **Shrimp Truck**: Lunch stop
- **Puaʻena Point**: Turtle spotting
- **Dole Plantation**: Enjoy Dole Whip and local attractions

meeting_point.address: Pick-up from a Waikiki hotel is required

data.what_is_included:
Air-conditioned vehicle
Narrated scenic drive
Lunch at Shrimp Truck
data.what_to_bring:
Paper voucher (if applicable)
Personal items for comfort
data.cancellation_summary: No refund unless canceled more than 24 hours before the start time.
data.cancellation_notes: No refund issued for cancellation unless made outside of 24 Hours from the Activity Start Time.
data.booking_notes:
PLEASE NOTE THAT YOU MUST BE PICKED UP FROM A WAIKIKI HOTEL IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS TOUR

If you were given a paper voucher, please bring it with you. 

Please allow a 10 min grace period on pick up times due to variable traffic in Waikiki. Mahalo!

No refund issued for cancellation unless made outside of 24 Hours from the Activity Start Time.

General Excise Tax of 4.7% and a 3% service fee is added to all retail rates. 

Please remember to bring all the personal items you will need to make your tour as pleasurable as possible. 

The reservations department may contact you to confirm your pickup information the night before your tour. If you do not receive a courtesy call, please call 808.926.3800.
data.check_in_details: The reservations department may contact you to confirm pickup the night before. If no call is received, contact 808.926.3800.
data.restrictions: - Must be picked up from a Waikiki hotel
data.faqs:
- **What happens if I don't receive a confirmation call?** Call 808.926.3800 for assistance.
- **Are children allowed?** Yes, children aged 4-11 have a discounted rate, and lapchildren (0-3) are free.
